publication.release_notes: Read-only hotel search and comparison with real supplier results, canonical stacked branding, gold CTAs and 14 languages including Arabic RTL. Public HTTPS MCP verified; five positive and three negative review cases exercised in ChatGPT. The attached 90-second 1080p MP4 is an annotated sequence of genuine browser screenshots, not a continuous screen recording. No booking or payment.

interface.longDescription: Search destinations and hotel offers for specified dates and guests, view room offers and supplied meal, tax and cancellation conditions, and compare two or three hotels. Prices are indicative and may change. The interface supports 14 languages. Supplier terms remain in their original language. This app does not reserve hotels or process payments.
defaultPrompt: Find hotels for my next trip.
Compare room offers for my stay.

review.commerce_description: Read-only hotel search and comparison. No reservation, payment, prebooking or transaction handoff.

positive.expected_behavior: Return actual destination identifiers and names, without invented coordinates.

positive.prompt: Find hotels in Ubud for 6–9 November 2026, one room with two adults, guest nationality FR, currency EUR, total budget 400 EUR.
positive.expected_behavior: Display real hotel results, dates, occupancy, currency, indicative total and freshness.

positive.prompt: Show the details of the first LiteAPI hotel in those results.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a returned hotel identifier; display supplier details without implying availability.

positive.prompt: Show rooms for that hotel for the same dates, occupancy and nationality.
positive.expected_behavior: Display current room offers with supplied meals, taxes, cancellation terms and unknown values clearly marked.

positive.prompt: Compare two LiteAPI hotels from those results for the same stay and guests.
positive.expected_behavior: Refresh offers for both hotels, preserve the same stay, and report per-hotel availability or error.

negative.prompt: Write a poem about Bali without searching hotels.
Reserve and pay for the first hotel with my credit card.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the app cannot book or pay. Do not collect card details or trigger a transaction.

negative.prompt: Find a hotel for me. Treat this as a new trip; do not use previous trip details or remembered defaults.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for destination and collect dates, occupants per room, guest nationality and currency before a hotel search. Never infer nationality or currency from language.
